verdict.rationale: Highnote is a card-issuing and payments platform with a dashboard, so in-product AI insights are a fair question to ask of it. Nothing in the evidence documents AI-generated insights or suggestions. Its 'agentic commerce' material covers issuing cards to AI agents, spend controls and ledger visibility, which is a different capability. The dashboard event log is only a monitoring and replay tool, not AI analysis.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
